translations.web: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
translations.bsb: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.
translations.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
